data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1110 experienced an overall gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 3.0 million in 2015. This was primarily driven by a GBP 7.7 million deficit (strengthening) on reinsurance accepted business, partially offset by a GBP 4.7 million surplus (release) on direct business. The adverse development on the 2014 year of account was largely due to large losses, particularly in US Marine Cargo, and a decrease in expected recoveries across Contractors and Professions. Favourable movements in outstanding case reserves for Engineering Short Tail and Non Marine Liability contributed to the positive result in the calendar year.

data.data_quality_notes: The net prior year development calculated from the net claims development triangle (+0.453m strengthening) differs from the net prior year development implied by the gross components of the run-off deviation (-4.7m release on direct + 7.7m strengthening on reinsurance = +3.0m gross strengthening). The narrative on page 6 also implies a net release of GBP 0.5m (1.1m profit on 2013 YOA - 1.6m loss on 2014 YOA). The most direct statement for gross PYD is the GBP 3.0m deficit on page 40, which has been used.
